name: v0.9.2
body:
### Fixed
- **Mappings now apply to findings with colons in their names.** Burp extension findings like "Trusted Types: Missing 'trusted-types' directive in CSP" showed as Unmapped on the Findings page even when a Ghostwriter mapping existed. They now resolve correctly, matching what the Mapping page already showed.
- **Report page dropdown no longer truncates report names.** The Target Report selector clipped long "Client - Project (Status)" labels in the open list; full labels now display.
- **Clearer Ghostwriter authentication errors.** When Ghostwriter (Hasura) rejects an unauthorized request, GhostPiper now surfaces the real "unauthorized" message instead of a confusing internal error.
- **No splash replay when sending findings to Mapping.** Jumping from Findings to the Mapping page in the same session no longer replays the launch animation.

### Improved
- **Fast, clear failure when Ghostwriter is unreachable.** Instead of a long hang, GhostPiper now fails fast with a hint to check your connection/VPN when the Ghostwriter host can't be reached.
